name: Founding of the Galactic Republic
summary: The Core Founders signed the Galactic Constitution on Coruscant, creating a Senate of member worlds under an elected Supreme Chancellor. The date became year zero of the Republic calendar and the start of the Old Republic era.

name: The Jedi make Ossus their home
summary: Leaving Tython behind, the Jedi settled Ossus at the far end of the Perlemian and began the library and praxeum that made it the Order's heart for twenty thousand years. From here they pledged themselves to defend the new Republic.

name: First Great Schism
summary: The Jedi Xendor rejected the Order's teachings, raised the Legions of Lettow and fought the first war between light and dark within the Jedi themselves. His death at Columus ended it, but the pattern of schism would repeat for millennia.

name: Tionese War
summary: The Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion, heirs of Xim, struck down the Perlemian at the young Republic. A century of raids and counter-raids ended only when Coruscant persuaded the Hutts to attack the Tionese from behind.

name: The Tion Cluster joins the Republic
summary: Caught between the Republic and Hutt raiders, the exhausted Tionese states accepted Republic membership. The Tion kept its pride and its memories of Xim, but its days as an independent power were over.

name: Great Manifest Period
summary: Three thousand years of settlement carried the Republic out past the Colonies into what became the Expansion Region. The new worlds were often little more than corporate estates, and resentment of Core control simmered for ages afterward.

name: The Alsakan Conflicts
summary: Seventeen times over fourteen thousand years, Alsakan and Coruscant fought for leadership of the Republic through their colonies and proxies. None of the wars broke the Republic, and Coruscant won every round that mattered.

name: Duinuogwuin Contention
summary: A flight of Duinuogwuin, the enormous Star Dragons, descended on Coruscant after a misunderstanding and the Republic's new Planetary Security Forces could not stop them. Jedi Master Jon Antilles talked both sides into peace, cementing the Jedi role as the Republic's mediators.

name: The Hutts abandon Varl for Nal Hutta
summary: Catastrophe left the Hutt homeworld Varl a ruin, and the clans moved their capital to Evocar, which they renamed Nal Hutta. The Hutt Cataclysms that followed broke the old Hutt Empire into the clan-ruled Hutt Space of later history.

name: Pius Dea Crusades

location.note: launched from Coruscant against Hutt Space and alien worlds

summary: A human-supremacist religious movement captured the chancellorship and sent thirty-four crusades against the Hutts and other alien peoples. The Jedi withdrew their support and eventually joined the Caamasi and Alsakani in bringing the regime down.

name: Fall of the Pius Dea Republic
summary: At the Battle of Uquine the Jedi-backed Renunciates defeated the Pius Dea fleet, ending a thousand years of crusading rule. The Jedi afterward accepted a formal role as the Republic's protectors in the Ruusan-era sense, bound to serve the Senate.

name: Mandalore the First conquers Mandalore
summary: The Taung warlord later called Mandalore the First led his people to a world on the Outer Rim, slew its mythosaurs and named it for himself. The Mandalorian warrior culture that followed would trouble the Republic for the next seven thousand years.

name: Second Great Schism
summary: A faction of Jedi who had learned to twist life itself with Sith-style alchemy broke from the Order rather than abandon their studies. Their rebellion opened the Hundred-Year Darkness.

name: Hundred-Year Darkness
summary: For a century the Dark Jedi and their alchemical monsters fought the Jedi and the Republic across the Rim. The war ended on the mining world Corbos, where the last Dark Jedi armies were broken.

name: Battle of Corbos
summary: The Jedi and the Republic's armies crushed the Dark Jedi at Corbos, ending the Hundred-Year Darkness. The surviving rebels were captured rather than killed, a mercy the galaxy would come to regret.

name: The Dark Jedi are banished beyond the Republic
summary: Rather than execute the defeated Dark Jedi, the Order stripped them of their weapons and shipped them into unexplored space beyond the Republic's frontier. The Exiles drifted for months before stumbling on a red world in the far east.

name: The Exiles land on Korriban
summary: The banished Dark Jedi found Korriban and its red-skinned, Force-strong Sith people, who took the newcomers for gods. Within a generation the Exiles had made themselves the ruling caste of a civilisation that would carry their name.

name: Founding of the Sith Empire
summary: Ajunta Pall and his fellow Exiles took the title of Sith Lords and built an empire over the Sith species, blending Jedi training with Sith sorcery. Cut off from the Republic, it grew in isolation for two thousand years.

name: Ajunta Pall becomes the first Dark Lord of the Sith
summary: The leader of the Exiles was proclaimed Jen'ari, Dark Lord of the Sith, a title every Sith ruler after him would claim. His regret over his choices was recorded in the tomb where Revan later found his spirit.

name: The Sith move their capital to Ziost
summary: As Korriban filled with the tombs of Dark Lords, the living government of the Sith Empire shifted to the colder, richer world of Ziost. Korriban remained the holy ground where power was legitimised and the dead were honoured.

name: Conquests of Tulak Hord
summary: The Dark Lord Tulak Hord, remembered as the greatest lightsaber duellist of his age, expanded the Sith Empire by conquest and left tombs and holocrons that later Sith studied for centuries. The exact dates of his reign are not recorded.

name: Golden age of Marka Ragnos
summary: Marka Ragnos ruled the Sith Empire for a century by playing its lords against one another, and under him the Sith reached their greatest wealth and reach. His death without a clear heir set Naga Sadow and Ludo Kressh at each other's throats.
